zh.caption: 圖 1｜三種工具，三個問題
zh.description: 三項平行訊號：技術嚴重度、已知利用與未來利用機率；仍需本地資產情境。

items.title: CVSS — 漏洞有多嚴重？
items.body: 好比門鎖的設計缺陷有多嚴重，以及被突破後可能有什麼後果。

items.title: KEV — 駭客真的利用過嗎？
items.body: 好比已經有可靠消息確認，竊賊正在利用這種門鎖缺陷作案。

items.title: EPSS — 接下來被利用的可能性有多高？
items.body: 好比根據過去案例與目前跡象，預測未來 30 天這類缺陷被用來作案的可能性。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Three tools, three questions
en.description: Parallel signals: technical severity, known exploitation and predicted exploitation. Local asset context is still required.

items.title: CVSS — How severe is it?
items.body: Like assessing a lock's design defect and the consequences of defeating it.

items.title: KEV — Has it actually been exploited?
items.body: Like reliable reports confirming burglars using this lock defect in real crimes.

items.title: EPSS — How likely is exploitation next?
items.body: Like predicting use of this defect in the next 30 days from past cases and current signals.

zh.caption: 圖 2｜CVSS v4.0 的四組指標
zh.description: 四組指標的用途不同；Supplemental 不改變分數。上下排列用於閱讀，不表示先後流程。

items.title: Base（基本）
items.body: 漏洞本身具備什麼技術特性？可能造成什麼後果？

items.title: Threat（威脅）
items.body: 是否已出現可用的利用技術，或實際利用活動？

items.title: Environmental（環境）
items.body: 放到我的公司後，系統的重要性、防護與實際條件有什麼差別？

items.title: Supplemental（補充）
items.body: 還有什麼額外資訊值得參考，例如復原困難程度？這組指標不改變 CVSS 分數。

en.caption: Figure 2 | Four CVSS v4.0 metric groups
en.description: Each group has a different purpose. Supplemental does not change the score. Rows are for reading, not a sequence.

items.title: Base
items.body: What intrinsic technical characteristics and possible consequences does the vulnerability have?

items.title: Threat
items.body: Are exploitation techniques available, or has exploitation activity occurred?

items.title: Environmental
items.body: How do system importance, defenses and actual conditions differ in my company?

items.title: Supplemental
items.body: What else matters, such as recovery difficulty? These metrics do not change the CVSS score.

zh.caption: 圖 3｜假設某漏洞的 EPSS
zh.description: 固定教學數值。藍色長條佔全長 20%，不表示修補進度或本機遭入侵的機率。

items.body:
代表模型預測，這個 CVE 在接下來 30 天於其觀測範圍內出現利用活動的機率約為 20%。

這是全球漏洞層級的預測，不是你的單一伺服器有 20% 的機率遭到入侵。

en.caption: Figure 3 | A hypothetical EPSS score
en.description: Fixed teaching value. The blue bar occupies 20% of its track; it is neither remediation progress nor a host-compromise probability.

items.body:
The model predicts about a 20% probability of observing exploitation activity for this CVE in the next 30 days within its observation scope.

This is a global vulnerability-level prediction, not a 20% chance that your individual server will be compromised.

zh.caption: 圖 4｜四個問題依序回答
zh.description: 箭頭表示定性判斷順序；這不是官方計分公式。CVSS 提供嚴重度，KEV／EPSS 補充不同威脅訊號。

items.title: 第一關：漏洞是否真的影響我的資產？
items.body: 確認產品、版本、設定、受影響功能

items.title: 第二關：漏洞與外部威脅訊號告訴我什麼？
items.body: CVSS、KEV、EPSS 及其他威脅情資

items.title: 第三關：攻擊者能接近嗎？影響多大？
items.body: 網路曝露、權限、防護、資料與業務重要性

items.title: 第四關：決定處理優先順序與措施
items.body: 立即緩解、安排修補、驗證、持續追蹤

en.caption: Figure 4 | Answer four questions in sequence
en.description: Arrows show a qualitative decision sequence, not an official scoring formula. CVSS supplies severity; KEV and EPSS supply different threat signals.

items.title: Gate 1: Does it actually affect my asset?
items.body: Confirm product, version, configuration and affected feature.

items.title: Gate 2: What do vulnerability and external threat signals tell us?
items.body: CVSS, KEV, EPSS and other threat intelligence.

items.title: Gate 3: Can an attacker reach it, and what would the impact be?
items.body: Network exposure, privileges, defenses, data and business importance.

items.title: Gate 4: Decide remediation priority and measures.
items.body: Immediate mitigation, scheduled patching, verification and continued tracking.
